verdict.rationale: Expensify's own materials describe a built-in AI assistant that takes plain-language requests to create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses, configure workspaces and rules, and answer spend questions with charts. A Concierge agent also auto-submits reports on the user's timeline. A 2017 community comment calling Concierge human-powered is about old support-reply turnaround, not these current AI features, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond blog/marketing copy (limits, permissions, confirmation flow), and independent hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Create, categorize, tag, approve, and reject expenses using plain language, no clicking required
Configure workspaces, build rules, and fix your own setup mistakes by just asking
Get instant answers and charts for anything in your account, from monthly spend to a full quarterly flux analysis
Automatically submits reports based on your timeline
